top5.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion
top5.description: OpenAI reportedly raised an additional $11 billion, giving it a valuation of $1.25 trillion.
top5.why: OpenAI’s reported $11 billion raise at a $1.25 trillion valuation underscores the enormous capital requirements and market expectations surrounding frontier AI.

top5.title: AMD now defines itself as a data center-focused company
top5.description: CEO Lisa Su says server chips now define AMD, with the data center segment accounting for about 63% of third-quarter 2026 revenue. Quarterly revenue reached $13.4 billion, while gaming sales fell 40%.
top5.why: AMD’s shift toward a data-center identity, with that segment generating 63% of revenue, highlights how AI infrastructure is reshaping the chip industry.

top5.title: Fox finalizes $22 billion acquisition of Roku
top5.description: Fox has completed its $22 billion acquisition of Roku, strengthening its position in streaming and connected TV. The deal gives Fox direct access to more than 100 million households and is expected to improve ad targeting.
top5.why: Fox’s $22 billion acquisition of Roku significantly strengthens its position in connected-TV distribution, advertising, and access to more than 100 million households.

top5.title: Apple beats forecasts with record quarterly results
top5.description: Apple generated 114.5 billion dollars in revenue in the fourth quarter of 2026, beating Wall Street forecasts and its previous quarterly record from the 2020 holiday season.
top5.why: Apple’s record $114.5 billion quarterly revenue shows continuing strength in its core business despite supply and cost pressures.

top5.title: U.S. charges three men in CEO voice scam
top5.description: Three men are facing charges in the United States over a $129 million fraud scheme that allegedly used AI to imitate the voices of corporate executives.
top5.why: U.S. charges over a $129 million executive-voice fraud scheme demonstrate that AI-enabled impersonation is becoming a material corporate-security and financial risk.
